$description: Seametry design tokens. W3C Design Tokens Community Group format. Single source of truth: never hand-edit generated tokens.css or tokens.ts.

dark.$description: The touchstone. Olive-black operational surfaces, in the hue of the house's deck (clients/web/public/Slide-*.png, ground #171C03).

ground.$description: Operational olive-black ground, a step quieter than the deck's #171C03 so feature surfaces still read above it.

sheet.$description: Each step above the ground loses chroma as it gains lightness (OKLCH 0.024, 0.021, 0.019 at hue 122), so a pane reads as a lighter olive-black, not khaki (Storm, 30 October 2026).

primary.$description: Bone, as on the deck. 15.34:1 on ground, 11.11:1 on tray.

secondary.$description: Readable supporting text. 8.93:1 on ground, 6.47:1 on tray.

tertiary.$description: Lowest readable text step. 6.82:1 on ground, 4.94:1 on tray.

faint.$description: Decorative only. Never for text a user must read.

onTouch.$description: Text on the touch fill. 7.21:1 on touch, 6.38:1 on touchPressed.

highlight.$description: Top-edge hairline on raised surfaces. The only light effect allowed.

touch.$description: Fill on keys and full-round controls only, the deck's lime. 7.19:1 against the ground, so the control reads as a shape before its label is read.

provenance.$description: Muted provenance mark, outline and focus ring. Never bare text.

provenanceField.$description: Bars beside green, chart fills, chips. Never a surface larger than a chip.

touchText.$description: Light lime for links and small touchable marks. 9.34:1 on ground, 6.77:1 on tray.

status.$description: Reserved for purchase outcome icons. Meaning is repeated in text.

figure.$description: Reserved for hero instruments' drawn parts. Never text and never a surface.

frozen.$description: An issuer-frozen leg: its collar, padlock and held Claim. A saturated brick, because status.error is a pastel in dark and read as pink (Storm, 12 October 2026).

feature.$description: The olive track. Reserved for named feature surfaces (see foundations.md section 5b): hero sections, alloy ceremony panels, sponsor profile headers, the Explorer landing. Never the default app background.

secondary.$description: 8.64:1 on feature.ground, 7.84:1 on feature.sheet; restricted to feature.ground/sheet, see foundations.md 5b.

light.$description: The certificate paper. Pale ground and defined reading sheets.

ground.$description: Pale mineral paper behind operational content; reading areas sit on elevated sheets.

tertiary.$description: Lowest readable text step, at least 4.5:1 even on tray.

onTouch.$description: Text on the touch fill. 7.21:1 on touch, 6.38:1 on touchPressed.

touch.$description: The deck's lime, the same fill as dark mode so the action green never drifts between modes. A step brighter than the #8DA32C it replaced, which held its label at only 5.95:1 and its icon at 4.59:1 (Storm, 12 October 2026).

provenance.$description: Provenance mark, outline and focus ring on paper. Never bare text.

touchText.$description: Deep olive for links on pale paper and elevated sheets.

status.$description: Reserved for purchase outcome icons. Meaning is repeated in text.

figure.$description: Reserved for hero instruments' drawn parts. Never text and never a surface.

frozen.$description: An issuer-frozen leg: its collar, padlock and held Claim, in a muted brick (Storm, 12 October 2026).

feature.$description: Light-mode olive track, same restriction as dark.

digest.$description: Hashes, addresses, signatures only. Never labels.

data.$description: Rules, rows, figures. Information reads as printed.

control.$description: Anything a finger or cursor acts on.

sheet.$description: Mobile sheets, matching the device corner.

content.$description: The app shell and its pages: dense tables read best at this measure.

public.$description: The public pages: the landing's figures and cards need more room than the app's tables on a desktop screen (Storm, 24 October 2026). Phones are unaffected; below it the page fills the screen with its own gutters.

sheet.$description: A side sheet's slide in and out. Long enough to read as a surface arriving, not a flash (Storm, 14 October 2026).

overlay.$description: A centre dialog or a toast entering and leaving.

linger.$description: How long a finished toast stays; its countdown bar runs exactly this long and its end removes the toast.

glide.$description: Arrives fast and settles slowly, for surfaces that slide in: sheets, dialogs, toasts.

scale.$description: Generated by scripts/generate-scale.mjs. Do not hand-edit. Raw perceptual material, 12 steps each (50 lightest to 900 darkest... wait see note).
scale.$note: Steps run 50 (darkest, low-lightness end) to 900 (lightest) in this build; treat as raw material, not usage tokens.
